overview.lead: Gnomes are one of the five Alliance races the Olympus guides name. Their racial Eureka! is an 8 sec buff that makes non-periodic abilities 10% cheaper and stronger, and Gnome Priest is new for the Alliance in Forever.

points.text: The class guides name Gnomes for Rogue, Priest, Mage and Warlock. Gnome Priests are new for the Alliance in Forever.
Engineering Specialization no longer adds skill. It makes engineering devices fail and backfire less often.
No racial grants weapon skill in Forever, so a Gnome's weapon choice is free of racial math.

heldBack.text: Gnome Eureka! now also boosts Power Word: Shield, and Human Divine Grace is an instant heal on an ally under 50% health that clears Weakened Soul (5 min cooldown).
heldBack.reason: Discipline tip with no grade or source; no reviewed fact says Eureka! covers Power Word: Shield.

heldBack.text: Alliance racials add tools: Dwarf Chastise roots humanoids, Gnome Confounding Flash confuses up to 5 nearby enemies, and Night Elf Elune's Grace makes melee and ranged attacks miss you more often.
heldBack.reason: PvP prose with no grade or source. The PvP chapter waits for a reviewed fact.

heldBack.text: Warcraft Tavern names Human (Will to Survive breaks stuns) and Gnome (Escape Artist) as strong Alliance PvP races.
heldBack.reason: PvP prose with no grade or source. The PvP chapter waits for a reviewed fact.

heldBack.text: Blink breaks stuns and roots, and Warcraft Tavern rates Gnome Escape Artist and Human Will to Survive as strong PvP racials.

101.summary: Eureka! in numbers, the Gnome Engineering racial, and the Gnome Priest, new in Forever.

steps.text: Eureka! is an 8 sec buff. While it lasts, your non-periodic abilities are 10% cheaper and stronger.
Fill those 8 seconds with non-periodic abilities, the only kind Eureka! improves.
Leave weapon skill out of your plans: no racial grants it in Forever.

mistakes.mistake: Spending the Eureka! window on effects that work over time.
mistakes.fix: Eureka! makes non-periodic abilities 10% cheaper and stronger, so use direct spells and attacks inside it.

mistakes.mistake: Choosing Gnome for a weapon-skill bonus.
mistakes.fix: No racial grants weapon skill in Forever.

chapters.title: What starts Eureka!
chapters.unavailable: The site's facts give Eureka!'s length and effect, but not what starts it or how often it can happen. This chapter waits for a reviewed fact.

steps.text: Engineering Specialization no longer adds Engineering skill in Forever.
It now cuts the failure and backfire rate of engineering devices by 20%.
Level Engineering as any other race would: the racial gives no head start in skill.

mistakes.mistake: Counting on the Gnome racial for bonus Engineering skill, as older guides do.
mistakes.fix: In Forever it adds no skill. It cuts the failure and backfire rate of engineering devices by 20%.

steps.text: Gnome Priest is one of the Alliance's new race and class combinations in Forever, next to Human Hunter and Dwarf Shaman.
Plan the racial spell quests at levels 10 and 20. A Gnome Priest unlocks Confounding Flash and Contingency Plan.
Fear Ward and Devouring Plague need no quest: every Priest race learns both at 20.

mistakes.mistake: Following another race's Priest spell list as a Gnome.
mistakes.fix: Gnome Priests unlock Confounding Flash and Contingency Plan. Desperate Prayer and Chastise are the Dwarf spells.

chapters.title: Gnome racials in PvP
chapters.unavailable: The site holds no reviewed fact on what Gnome racials do in PvP, such as Escape Artist. This chapter waits for one.

201.summary: How Eureka! compares with the other Alliance racials for a raiding Mage.

chapters.title: Eureka! next to the other Mage racials

steps.text: For a raiding Mage, compare the three Alliance racials the Mage guide lists: Human Ruthless +1% crit, Gnome Eureka! (an 8 sec buff that makes non-periodic abilities 10% cheaper and stronger) and High Order Skyborne Wind-Blessed +2% haste.
Weigh Eureka! by how much of your damage comes from non-periodic spells, since those are the only ones it improves.

mistakes.mistake: Comparing a Gnome Mage against a Human Mage whose Ruthless is still 2% crit.
mistakes.fix: Ruthless is +1% crit since the 26 October notes.
